milestones.blessing: Three days in a row: what the Church calls a triduum, three days of prayer before a feast.
Seven days in a row: a whole week of the Rosary.
Nine days in a row: a novena, as the Apostles prayed for nine days before Pentecost.
Thirty-three days, as long as St. Louis de Montfort's Consecration to Mary.
Forty days in a row: the length of Lent, and of the Lord's fast in the desert.
Fifty days in a row: from Easter to Pentecost, when the Holy Ghost came down on the Apostles.
54 days in a row, as long as the Rosary novena: 27 days asking, then 27 giving thanks.
Some seed fell on good soil and brought forth fruit a hundredfold.
A hundred and fifty days in a row: one for each Hail Mary of the full Rosary, Our Lady's Psalter.
A full year of daily prayer, for the greater glory of God.
Five hundred days in a row: a candle kept burning before her, day after day.
A thousand days in a row. A thousand years in His sight are as yesterday, which is past.
